Your appeal means a lot to me, I love hearing that people like my character designs!
A sketch sheet would be wonderful, especially showing her different outfits.

https://imgur.com/NPU4Cm8

Thank you so much for the appeal! I’d be honored for you to draw her in anyway you see fit. She has multiple outfits, as well as a separate angel (pink hair) and human (blonde hair) form. She also has a magical black cat named beans. I’d love a sketch sheet or really anything you wanna draw!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QGrFnoEmv98zuQP24ci-TeCl7M9xmB3k

Hi! I really like your drawings!  I would like to request a full-body drawing of my character. My character is tall, tanned skinned, cool, mature and has bunny ears(instead of human ears).

I would like you to draw my character in the outfits that is similar to what the model wears in the reference(hat included and the pink arm glove is not needed). Feel free to adjust the colorings and details. If you feel like drawing the hat, you can make holes on the hat for bunny ears to poke through! Just a reminder, my character has navel piercing. I would also like my character to get a tattoo designed by you at the same position of body as the model(beneath boob, above waist). If possible, I would also like you to draw my character's finger nails with paints. 

Everything else is up to your freedom.

Hello there,
Thank you very much for your appeal!
I would be happy for you to draw Seo, with Alisa (her brown haired fairy companion) if possible.
Seo is a very friendly gyaru who loves to hang out with friends and flirt with people every now and then, like a typical gyaru. Loves fashion, cooking and cleaning.
Alisa is Seo's fairy partner who helps her cast magic. A very lazy NEET who likes to draw manga. Prefers yuri and yaoi.
Feel free to draw them however you see fit.
I look forward to your work!

Seo & Alisa: https://photos.app.goo.gl/5nG89M2fYF6M4wmc9

Hello and thank you for the appeal! 🥰 Your art looks lovely and I’d love to be able to order a piece from you! 

Yui: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-8at0X49q7u6DFIG8q6sOKIEQQM0tMmb

To give a little more details to help, she’s a playful and cheerful character with a very seductive and flirty personality. She’s confident in her body, especially her butt and loves to show it off, often wearing outfits that show a lot of skin and loves the beach and yoga 💞 I’ll leave the composition up to you so feel free to choose whatever pose and outfit you feel fits! ✨ 💞 

Thank you for the opportunity! （╹◡╹）♡

Howdy!! I received your appeal to draw me and i would be thrilled if you could!

Ill let you decide what to do for the art, ill just give a brief description of my VTuber!

His name is Ace Ayune, he's a magic oracle femboy that's 4'9" (148 cm), he's very chaotic, and mischevious. He loves cute things and can be flustered easily, but can also be aggressive, though he's not very intimidating since he's very short. A lot of his backstory has to do with space, sunsets, and monsters like Cthulhu!

Please draw him however you’d like!

Hello! I absolutely adore your artwork and artstyle! I’d like to get a piece of my friend LonNolan and Myself in an action pose. 

LonNolan is a Warrior who fights with his Sword. Flare is a Phoenix King whos wings and feather crown are made of fire. He can also summon fire if need be. 

Pose and Composition are up to you. I just want it to look like LonNolan and Flare are working together to fight a common foe. 

Thank you!

Flare: https://imgur.com/a/5PCAEol
LonNolan: https://imgur.com/a/4wyISHM

Hello! I wanted to see if I can get a skeb of my OC Geitor and two of his friends Taiga and Smol. The overall style of the art is like in Warhammer 40k's [Adeptus Mechanicus], primarily the [Skitarii Ranger] units. And the drawing plays off of the meme of the Pope who's holding something up as if he's blessing it.

From the waist up is Geitor who isn't wearing his hat this time, is holding up Taiga. A ray of light shines down on Taiga as if she is blessed. Smol, from the waist up as well, is holding a fancy toaster to his chest in the background dressed similarly to Geitor is in shock and awe of Taiga. His cat ears protrude through his hood.

The interior of the scene is similar to the inside of a dark room within a sci-fi temple. A computer monitor glowing dimly in the background, a few lit candles, and an alter.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E36Wm-nHMck43M3gYUJTZ6i4koq4NRR1?usp=drive_link
